Plugin.Name: GPUTuner
Plugin.Author: onyxhq-dev
Plugin.Overview: Native plugin version of GPU Tuner for NVIDIA cards: set the power limit, fan curve and core clock cap per GPU from a page inside the Unraid UI (no separate web UI or password), with a combined power budget and safety floors. No Docker needed. Requires the NVIDIA Driver plugin. Based on 0sy/gpu-tuner-unraid and willboyden/gpu-tuner (both MIT).
Plugin.Description: NVIDIA GPU power, fan and clock control inside the Unraid UI, as a plugin.
